expansionNote.en: Georgia operates a partial Medicaid expansion called Georgia Pathways to Coverage. Approved by CMS in 2023 and extended through December 31, 2026, Pathways covers adults ages 19 to 64 with household income up to 100% of the Federal Poverty Level who complete at least 80 hours per month of qualifying activities such as work, job training, or education. Georgia has not adopted the full ACA Medicaid expansion to 138% FPL that 40 states and DC have implemented. Adults who do not meet Pathways activity requirements and are not parents of dependent children, pregnant, disabled, or 65 or older generally do not qualify for Georgia Medicaid coverage.
expansionNote.es: Georgia opera una expansion parcial de Medicaid llamada Georgia Pathways to Coverage. Aprobada por CMS en 2023 y extendida hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026, Pathways cubre a adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos familiares de hasta el 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza que completen al menos 80 horas por mes de actividades calificadas, como trabajo, capacitacion laboral o educacion. Georgia no ha adoptado la expansion completa de Medicaid del ACA al 138% del FPL que 40 estados y DC han implementado. Los adultos que no cumplen con los requisitos de actividad de Pathways y no son padres de hijos dependientes, no estan embarazadas, no tienen discapacidad ni tienen 65 anos o mas generalmente no califican para cobertura de Medicaid de Georgia.

subhero.en: Georgia is a partial Medicaid expansion state. The Georgia Pathways to Coverage program extends Medicaid to adults ages 19 to 64 with incomes up to 100% of the Federal Poverty Level ($15,960 for a single person in 2026, $33,000 for a household of four) who complete 80 hours per month of qualifying work or training activities. Pregnant women qualify up to 220% FPL ($35,112 for a single person). Children qualify for Georgia Medicaid up to 133% FPL, and PeachCare for Kids (CHIP) extends coverage to 247% FPL. Applications go through the Georgia Gateway portal at gateway.ga.gov.
subhero.es: Georgia es un estado de expansion parcial de Medicaid. El programa Georgia Pathways to Coverage extiende Medicaid a adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos de hasta el 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($15,960 para una persona en 2026, $33,000 para un hogar de cuatro) que completen 80 horas por mes de actividades calificadas de trabajo o capacitacion. Las mujeres embarazadas califican hasta el 220% del FPL ($35,112 para una persona). Los ninos califican para Medicaid de Georgia hasta el 133% del FPL, y PeachCare for Kids (CHIP) extiende la cobertura hasta el 247% del FPL. Las solicitudes se realizan a traves del portal Georgia Gateway en gateway.ga.gov.

quickAnswer.en: Georgia Medicaid income limits in 2026 depend on which population group applies. Adults ages 19 to 64 qualify through Georgia Pathways to Coverage if household income is at or below 100% of the Federal Poverty Level ($15,960 for one person, $33,000 for a household of four) AND they complete at least 80 hours per month of qualifying activities. Pregnant women qualify up to 220% FPL ($35,112 for one person, $72,600 for a household of four) with no activity requirement. Children qualify for Georgia Medicaid up to 133% FPL; PeachCare for Kids (CHIP) bridges coverage from 134% to 247% FPL. Traditional parents and caretakers qualify at approximately 35% FPL with dependent children. Georgia Medicaid is administered by the Georgia Department of Community Health (DCH); apply at gateway.ga.gov or call 877-423-4746.
quickAnswer.es: Los limites de ingresos de Medicaid de Georgia en 2026 dependen del grupo de poblacion que aplica. Los adultos de 19 a 64 anos califican a traves de Georgia Pathways to Coverage si los ingresos del hogar estan al o por debajo del 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($15,960 para una persona, $33,000 para un hogar de cuatro) Y completan al menos 80 horas por mes de actividades calificadas. Las mujeres embarazadas califican hasta el 220% del FPL ($35,112 para una persona, $72,600 para un hogar de cuatro) sin requisito de actividad. Los ninos califican para Medicaid de Georgia hasta el 133% del FPL; PeachCare for Kids (CHIP) extiende la cobertura del 134% al 247% del FPL. Los padres y cuidadores tradicionales califican aproximadamente al 35% del FPL con hijos dependientes. Medicaid de Georgia es administrado por el Departamento de Salud Comunitaria de Georgia (DCH); solicite en gateway.ga.gov o llame al 877-423-4746.

introParagraphs.en: Georgia Medicaid is administered by the Georgia Department of Community Health (DCH), with financial eligibility determinations made by the Division of Family and Children Services (DFCS). Georgia holds a unique position among US states: it implemented a partial Medicaid expansion in 2023 through the Georgia Pathways to Coverage program rather than adopting the full Affordable Care Act expansion to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. As of 2026, Georgia Pathways is approved through December 31, 2026, and covers working-age adults who meet both an income test (up to 100% FPL, which is $15,960 for an individual in 2026 using the 2026 Federal Poverty Level) and an activity requirement of 80 hours per month. The 2026 Federal Poverty Level baseline for the 48 contiguous states is $15,960 for a household of one, increasing by $5,680 for each additional household member. All Georgia Medicaid thresholds below use this baseline.
introParagraphs.es: Medicaid de Georgia es administrado por el Departamento de Salud Comunitaria de Georgia (DCH), con determinaciones de elegibilidad financiera realizadas por la Division de Servicios Familiares e Infantiles (DFCS). Georgia ocupa una posicion unica entre los estados de EE.UU.: implemento una expansion parcial de Medicaid en 2023 a traves del programa Georgia Pathways to Coverage en lugar de adoptar la expansion completa de la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible al 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. A partir de 2026, Georgia Pathways esta aprobado hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026, y cubre a adultos en edad laboral que cumplen tanto una prueba de ingresos (hasta el 100% del FPL, que es $15,960 para un individuo en 2026) como un requisito de actividad de 80 horas por mes. La base del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 para los 48 estados contiguos es $15,960 para un hogar de una persona, aumentando en $5,680 por cada miembro adicional del hogar.

introParagraphs.en: Georgia Medicaid covers several distinct population groups, each with its own income threshold. Children under age 19 qualify for Georgia Medicaid at up to 133% FPL (about $21,227 per year for a single-child household). Pregnant women qualify under the Right from the Start Medicaid program at up to 220% FPL ($35,112 for a single person in 2026), with 12 months of postpartum coverage extended to the same income limit per the American Rescue Plan Act. Parents and caretaker relatives of dependent children who do not qualify through Pathways face a much tighter traditional limit of approximately 35% FPL (about $5,586 per year for a household of two with one child). Aged, blind, and disabled adults follow SSI-linked rules with an income limit near 100% of the Federal Benefit Rate and a $2,000 asset test. Each group applies through the same Georgia Gateway portal at gateway.ga.gov, though the documentation and processing timelines differ.
introParagraphs.es: Medicaid de Georgia cubre varios grupos de poblacion distintos, cada uno con su propio umbral de ingresos. Los ninos menores de 19 anos califican para Medicaid de Georgia hasta el 133% del FPL (aproximadamente $21,227 por ano para un hogar con un nino). Las mujeres embarazadas califican bajo el programa Medicaid Right from the Start hasta el 220% del FPL ($35,112 para una persona en 2026), con 12 meses de cobertura posparto extendida al mismo limite de ingresos segun la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano. Los padres y parientes cuidadores de hijos dependientes que no califican a traves de Pathways enfrentan un limite tradicional mucho mas estricto de aproximadamente el 35% del FPL (aproximadamente $5,586 por ano para un hogar de dos personas con un nino). Los adultos mayores, ciegos y discapacitados siguen las reglas vinculadas al SSI con un limite de ingresos cerca del 100% de la Tasa Federal de Beneficio y una prueba de bienes de $2,000.

introParagraphs.en: Georgia Medicaid enrolled approximately 1.87 million Georgians in 2026. Children and families make up the largest segment, followed by aged and disabled adults. The household-size table below shows the 2026 Georgia Medicaid income guidelines for three key populations: adults eligible through Pathways (100% FPL), children eligible through standard Medicaid (133% FPL), and pregnant women (220% FPL). If your household income exceeds the children's Medicaid limit but falls below 247% FPL, PeachCare for Kids covers the gap. If your income exceeds the Pathways limit and you are not otherwise covered, you may qualify for ACA marketplace subsidies through Healthcare.gov, which use the 2025 FPL for subsidy calculations in the 2026 plan year.
introParagraphs.es: Medicaid de Georgia inscribio a aproximadamente 1.87 millones de georgianos en 2026. La tabla de tamano de hogar a continuacion muestra las pautas de ingresos de Medicaid de Georgia 2026 para tres poblaciones clave: adultos elegibles a traves de Pathways (100% del FPL), ninos elegibles a traves de Medicaid estandar (133% del FPL) y mujeres embarazadas (220% del FPL). Si los ingresos de su hogar superan el limite de Medicaid para ninos pero caen por debajo del 247% del FPL, PeachCare for Kids cubre la brecha. Si sus ingresos superan el limite de Pathways y no esta cubierto de otra manera, puede calificar para subsidios del mercado del ACA a traves de Healthcare.gov.

caption.en: The 2026 Georgia Medicaid income guidelines below are based on the 2026 Federal Poverty Level for the 48 contiguous states. Adult column = Georgia Pathways to Coverage limit (100% FPL; 80 hr/mo activity requirement applies). Children column = standard Georgia children's Medicaid (133% FPL; ages 1-18). Pregnancy column = Right from the Start Medicaid (220% FPL). Add roughly $5,680 of annual income per additional household member beyond 8.
caption.es: Las pautas de ingresos de Medicaid de Georgia 2026 a continuacion se basan en el Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 para los 48 estados contiguos. Columna de adultos = limite de Georgia Pathways to Coverage (100% del FPL; se aplica requisito de actividad de 80 horas/mes). Columna de ninos = Medicaid estandar para ninos de Georgia (133% del FPL; edades 1-18). Columna de embarazo = Medicaid Right from the Start (220% del FPL). Agregue aproximadamente $5,680 de ingresos anuales por cada miembro adicional del hogar mas alla de 8.

footnote.en: All figures rounded to nearest dollar using 2026 HHS poverty guidelines (aspe.hhs.gov). The adult column reflects the Georgia Pathways income limit; adults must also meet the 80-hour monthly activity requirement. Traditional parent/caretaker Medicaid is capped near 35% FPL, far below the Pathways threshold. PeachCare for Kids (CHIP) extends children's coverage to 247% FPL. Infants ages 0-1 may qualify at up to 205% FPL under Right from the Start. Georgia Pathways is approved through December 31, 2026.
footnote.es: Todas las cifras redondeadas al dolar mas cercano utilizando las pautas de pobreza HHS 2026. La columna de adultos refleja el limite de ingresos de Georgia Pathways; los adultos tambien deben cumplir con el requisito de actividad mensual de 80 horas. El Medicaid tradicional para padres/cuidadores tiene un limite cercano al 35% del FPL, muy por debajo de Pathways. PeachCare for Kids (CHIP) extiende la cobertura de los ninos hasta el 247% del FPL. Los bebes de 0 a 1 ano pueden calificar hasta el 205% del FPL bajo Right from the Start. Georgia Pathways esta aprobado hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026.

intro.en: Georgia Medicaid eligibility depends on which program category applies to your household. All applicants must meet basic non-income criteria regardless of which income limit applies to their group. Georgia uses the federal Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) methodology to calculate income for most categories, though aged, blind, and disabled adults use the older SSI-based income and asset rules. The following non-income requirements apply to all Georgia Medicaid categories.
intro.es: La elegibilidad para Medicaid de Georgia depende de la categoria de programa que aplica a su hogar. Todos los solicitantes deben cumplir con los criterios basicos no relacionados con los ingresos independientemente del limite de ingresos que aplique a su grupo. Georgia utiliza la metodologia federal de Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para calcular los ingresos para la mayoria de las categorias, aunque los adultos mayores, ciegos y discapacitados utilizan las reglas de ingresos y bienes basadas en SSI.

items.en: Georgia residency (required): Applicants must live in Georgia at the time of application. A Georgia address on a utility bill, lease, mortgage statement, or government mail satisfies this requirement. There is no minimum length-of-residency requirement: you can apply on your first day in Georgia.
items.es: Residencia en Georgia (obligatorio): Los solicitantes deben vivir en Georgia en el momento de la solicitud. Una direccion de Georgia en una factura de servicios publicos, contrato de arrendamiento, estado de cuenta hipotecario o correo del gobierno satisface este requisito.

items.en: U.S. citizenship or qualifying immigration status: Most Georgia Medicaid categories require U.S. citizenship, lawful permanent residence, or another qualifying immigration status. Undocumented immigrants generally do not qualify for full Georgia Medicaid, though emergency Medicaid covers emergency medical conditions regardless of status. CHIP (PeachCare) has the same citizenship/status rules as Medicaid.
items.es: Ciudadania estadounidense o estatus migratorio calificado: La mayoria de las categorias de Medicaid de Georgia requieren ciudadania estadounidense, residencia permanente legal u otro estatus migratorio calificado. Los inmigrantes indocumentados generalmente no califican para Medicaid completo de Georgia, aunque el Medicaid de emergencia cubre condiciones medicas de emergencia independientemente del estatus.

items.en: Social Security Number (SSN): Georgia Medicaid requires an SSN for every household member applying for coverage. Children born in Georgia hospitals are often assigned an SSN through the hospital enrollment process; if your newborn does not yet have an SSN, you may apply and provide it within 30 days.
items.es: Numero de Seguro Social (SSN): Medicaid de Georgia requiere un SSN para cada miembro del hogar que solicite cobertura. Los ninos nacidos en hospitales de Georgia a menudo reciben un SSN a traves del proceso de inscripcion hospitalaria.

items.en: Georgia Pathways activity requirement (adults 19-64 only): In addition to the 100% FPL income test, Pathways applicants must demonstrate they are actively completing at least 80 hours per month of qualifying activities. Qualifying activities include paid employment, self-employment, job skills training, education (college enrollment counts as 1 credit hour = 4 hours per week), community service, compliance with SNAP work requirements, and caregiving for a child under age 6. Parents of children under age 6 are exempt from the activity requirement. Activity reporting is annual as of 2026.
items.es: Requisito de actividad de Georgia Pathways (solo adultos de 19 a 64 anos): Ademas de la prueba de ingresos del 100% del FPL, los solicitantes de Pathways deben demostrar que completan activamente al menos 80 horas por mes de actividades calificadas. Las actividades calificadas incluyen empleo remunerado, autoempleo, capacitacion laboral, educacion, servicio comunitario, cumplimiento con los requisitos de trabajo de SNAP y cuidado de un nino menor de 6 anos. Los padres de ninos menores de 6 anos estan exentos del requisito de actividad.

items.en: Household composition and dependent-child status: Traditional Georgia Medicaid for non-disabled non-elderly adults generally requires a dependent child in the household. Adults without dependent children who do not qualify through Pathways and are not pregnant, disabled, or 65 or older typically fall into the Georgia coverage gap (above the Medicaid threshold but potentially below ACA marketplace subsidy eligibility, which starts at 100% FPL using the 2025 FPL for the 2026 plan year).
items.es: Composicion del hogar y estado de hijo dependiente: El Medicaid tradicional de Georgia para adultos no discapacitados y no mayores generalmente requiere un nino dependiente en el hogar. Los adultos sin hijos dependientes que no califican a traves de Pathways y no estan embarazadas, discapacitados o tienen 65 anos o mas tipicamente caen en la brecha de cobertura de Georgia.

items.en: Asset test for aged, blind, and disabled (ABD) Medicaid: MAGI categories (children, pregnant women, Pathways adults, parents) do not have an asset test. However, ABD Medicaid for aged (65+), blind, and disabled adults uses a $2,000 asset limit for an individual and $3,000 for a couple. Excluded assets include the primary home (up to federal equity limits), one vehicle, personal property, and certain burial accounts. Georgia nursing home Medicaid applies a 300% SSI special income limit ($2,982 per month for an individual in 2026) and the federal 60-month lookback period for asset transfers.
items.es: Prueba de bienes para Medicaid de adultos mayores, ciegos y discapacitados (ABD): Las categorias MAGI (ninos, mujeres embarazadas, adultos de Pathways, padres) no tienen prueba de bienes. Sin embargo, el Medicaid ABD para adultos mayores (65+), ciegos y discapacitados utiliza un limite de bienes de $2,000 para un individuo y $3,000 para una pareja.

items.en: Other health coverage: Georgia Medicaid is a payer of last resort. If you have employer-sponsored coverage or other private insurance, Georgia Medicaid may pay cost-sharing but generally does not replace employer coverage unless the employer coverage is deemed unaffordable under state rules. Medicaid beneficiaries who also have Medicare are dual-eligible and may qualify for Medicare Savings Programs that help pay Medicare premiums and cost-sharing.
items.es: Otra cobertura de salud: Medicaid de Georgia es el pagador de ultimo recurso. Si tiene cobertura patrocinada por un empleador u otro seguro privado, Medicaid de Georgia puede pagar el costo compartido pero generalmente no reemplaza la cobertura del empleador. Los beneficiarios de Medicaid que tambien tienen Medicare son dual-elegibles y pueden calificar para Programas de Ahorro de Medicare.

intro.en: Georgia Medicaid uses the federal Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) methodology for most categories, including Georgia Pathways, children, pregnant women, and parents. MAGI is essentially the income you report on your federal tax return, with a small set of additions and subtractions. Georgia does not apply the federal 5% income disregard for the Pathways program, meaning the posted 100% FPL limit is the effective limit. Aged, blind, and disabled (ABD) Medicaid uses older SSI-based income rules that count in-kind support and impose stricter exclusions. The list below applies to MAGI categories.
intro.es: Medicaid de Georgia utiliza la metodologia federal de Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para la mayoria de las categorias, incluidos Georgia Pathways, ninos, mujeres embarazadas y padres. MAGI es esencialmente el ingreso que reporta en su declaracion de impuestos federales, con un pequeno conjunto de adiciones y sustracciones. Georgia no aplica el descuento de ingresos del 5% federal para el programa Pathways, lo que significa que el limite publicado del 100% del FPL es el limite efectivo.

included.en: Wages, salaries, and tips (W-2 income): All gross employment income before taxes and deductions counts toward Georgia Medicaid MAGI.
included.es: Salarios, sueldos y propinas (ingresos W-2): Todos los ingresos brutos de empleo antes de impuestos y deducciones cuentan para el MAGI de Medicaid de Georgia.

included.en: Self-employment net income: Net profit from self-employment (after allowable business deductions) reported on Schedule C, Schedule E, or Schedule F counts as MAGI income. Gross self-employment income minus deductible business expenses equals the counted amount.
included.es: Ingresos netos por autoempleo: Las ganancias netas del autoempleo (despues de las deducciones comerciales permitidas) reportadas en el Anexo C, E o F cuentan como ingreso MAGI.

included.en: Social Security retirement and survivor benefits: The taxable portion of Social Security retirement and survivor benefits counts as MAGI income. If your Social Security benefits are not taxable (because your total income is below the IRS threshold), the untaxed portion does not count.
included.es: Beneficios de Seguro Social por jubilacion y sobreviviente: La porcion imponible de los beneficios de jubilacion y sobreviviente del Seguro Social cuenta como ingreso MAGI.

included.en: Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI): SSDI benefits are counted as MAGI income (same taxability rule as retirement benefits). Note that SSDI recipients who meet the Supplemental Security Income (SSI) requirements may qualify for ABD Medicaid, which uses different income rules.
included.es: Seguro de Discapacidad del Seguro Social (SSDI): Los beneficios de SSDI se cuentan como ingreso MAGI (la misma regla de imposicion que los beneficios de jubilacion).

included.en: Interest, dividends, and capital gains: Taxable interest and dividends from bank accounts, investments, and brokerage accounts count as MAGI income. Capital gains from the sale of stocks, real estate, or other assets count in the year realized.
included.es: Intereses, dividendos y ganancias de capital: Los intereses y dividendos imponibles de cuentas bancarias, inversiones y cuentas de corretaje cuentan como ingreso MAGI.

included.en: Pension and retirement distributions: Taxable distributions from 401(k), 403(b), IRA, and pension accounts count as MAGI income. Roth IRA qualified distributions may not count (consult DFCS for current treatment).
included.es: Pensiones y distribuciones de jubilacion: Las distribuciones imponibles de cuentas 401(k), 403(b), IRA y de pension cuentan como ingreso MAGI.

included.en: Unemployment compensation: All unemployment benefits received from the Georgia Department of Labor count as MAGI income in the year received.
included.es: Compensacion por desempleo: Todos los beneficios de desempleo recibidos del Departamento de Trabajo de Georgia cuentan como ingreso MAGI en el ano recibido.

included.en: Alimony received under pre-2019 divorce decrees: Alimony or separate maintenance payments received under divorce agreements finalized before January 1, 2019 count as MAGI income. Alimony under agreements finalized on or after January 1, 2019 does not count (Tax Cuts and Jobs Act change).
included.es: Pension alimenticia recibida bajo decretos de divorcio anteriores a 2019: Los pagos de pension alimenticia recibidos bajo acuerdos de divorcio finalizados antes del 1 de enero de 2019 cuentan como ingreso MAGI.

excluded.en: Supplemental Security Income (SSI): SSI cash benefits are NOT counted as MAGI income for Georgia Medicaid. SSI recipients automatically qualify for ABD Medicaid, which has a separate eligibility path.
excluded.es: Ingreso de Seguridad Suplementario (SSI): Los beneficios en efectivo de SSI NO se cuentan como ingreso MAGI para Medicaid de Georgia. Los receptores de SSI califican automaticamente para Medicaid ABD.

excluded.en: Child support received: Child support payments received from a non-custodial parent are excluded from MAGI income for Georgia Medicaid purposes.
excluded.es: Manutencion infantil recibida: Los pagos de manutencion infantil recibidos de un padre no custodio estan excluidos del ingreso MAGI para propositos de Medicaid de Georgia.

excluded.en: Veterans' benefits (VA disability compensation, pension, GI Bill): VA disability payments, veterans' pensions, and GI Bill educational benefits are excluded from MAGI income.
excluded.es: Beneficios para veteranos (compensacion por discapacidad de VA, pension, GI Bill): Los pagos de discapacidad de VA, las pensiones de veteranos y los beneficios educativos del GI Bill estan excluidos del ingreso MAGI.

excluded.en: Workers' compensation: Payments received for work-related injury or illness under Georgia workers' compensation law are excluded from MAGI income.
excluded.es: Compensacion de trabajadores: Los pagos recibidos por lesiones o enfermedades relacionadas con el trabajo bajo la ley de compensacion de trabajadores de Georgia estan excluidos del ingreso MAGI.

excluded.en: TANF cash assistance: Temporary Assistance for Needy Families cash grants are excluded from MAGI income.
excluded.es: Asistencia en efectivo de TANF: Las subvenciones en efectivo de Asistencia Temporal para Familias Necesitadas estan excluidas del ingreso MAGI.

excluded.en: Gifts, inheritances, and loan proceeds: One-time gifts, inheritances, and proceeds from personal loans are excluded from MAGI income. These items are not counted as income for federal tax purposes and therefore not counted for MAGI.
excluded.es: Regalos, herencias y ganancias de prestamos: Los regalos unicos, herencias y ganancias de prestamos personales estan excluidos del ingreso MAGI.

excluded.en: Foster care payments: Payments received for providing foster care services are excluded from MAGI income.
excluded.es: Pagos de cuidado de crianza: Los pagos recibidos por brindar servicios de cuidado de crianza estan excluidos del ingreso MAGI.

intro.en: Georgia Medicaid applications are submitted through the Georgia Gateway Customer Portal (gateway.ga.gov), which is operated by the Georgia Department of Human Services Division of Family and Children Services (DFCS). The same Gateway application handles Medicaid, Georgia Pathways to Coverage, PeachCare for Kids (CHIP), SNAP, TANF, and other programs simultaneously. Applicants can also apply by calling 877-423-4746, visiting a county DFCS office in person, or mailing Form 297 (Application for Assistance) to their local DFCS office. The Georgia Department of Community Health (DCH) sets policy; DFCS makes financial eligibility determinations.
intro.es: Las solicitudes de Medicaid de Georgia se envian a traves del Portal de Cliente Georgia Gateway (gateway.ga.gov), que es operado por la Division de Servicios Familiares e Infantiles (DFCS) del Departamento de Servicios Humanos de Georgia. La misma solicitud de Gateway maneja Medicaid, Georgia Pathways to Coverage, PeachCare for Kids (CHIP), SNAP, TANF y otros programas simultaneamente. Los solicitantes tambien pueden presentar la solicitud llamando al 877-423-4746, visitando una oficina del condado DFCS en persona, o enviando por correo el Formulario 297.

steps.en: 1. Gather your documents before you start: photo ID, Social Security cards for all household members applying, proof of Georgia residency, proof of citizenship or immigration status, and the last 30 days of pay stubs (or most recent tax return for self-employed applicants). For Pathways, also gather documentation of your qualifying activities (pay stubs, employer letter, enrollment records, or community service logs).
steps.es: 1. Reunir sus documentos antes de comenzar: identificacion con foto, tarjetas de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar que soliciten, comprobante de residencia en Georgia, comprobante de ciudadania o estatus migratorio y los ultimos 30 dias de talones de pago. Para Pathways, tambien reuna documentacion de sus actividades calificadas.

steps.en: 2. Create a Georgia Gateway account at gateway.ga.gov or log in if you already have one. Select 'Apply for Benefits' and choose 'Medicaid' (and 'Georgia Pathways' if you are an adult seeking coverage through Pathways). You can add SNAP or other programs to the same application without slowing the process.
steps.es: 2. Crear una cuenta de Georgia Gateway en gateway.ga.gov o iniciar sesion si ya tiene una. Seleccione 'Solicitar beneficios' y elija 'Medicaid' (y 'Georgia Pathways' si es un adulto que busca cobertura a traves de Pathways).

steps.en: 3. Complete the online application: list every household member, report all income sources and amounts, and answer questions about your immigration status, residency, and any other health coverage. Georgia Pathways applicants must describe their qualifying activities and provide the relevant documentation at this step.
steps.es: 3. Completar la solicitud en linea: listar a todos los miembros del hogar, reportar todas las fuentes e importes de ingresos, y responder preguntas sobre su estatus migratorio, residencia y cualquier otra cobertura de salud.

steps.en: 4. Upload or attach supporting documents through the Gateway document upload tool. If you cannot upload documents online, you may fax or mail them to your local DFCS office or bring them in person. Label every document with your case number shown on your application confirmation.
steps.es: 4. Cargar o adjuntar documentos de respaldo a traves de la herramienta de carga de documentos de Gateway. Si no puede cargar documentos en linea, puede enviarlos por fax o por correo a su oficina local de DFCS o llevarlos en persona.

steps.en: 5. Sign and submit the application. Georgia Gateway sends an email confirmation with your case number immediately after submission. Save this confirmation because you will need the case number if you contact DFCS to follow up.
steps.es: 5. Firmar y enviar la solicitud. Georgia Gateway envía una confirmacion por correo electronico con su numero de caso inmediatamente despues del envio. Guarde esta confirmacion.

steps.en: 6. Respond promptly to any DFCS requests for additional information. DFCS sends notices through your Gateway account and by mail. Failing to respond within the requested timeframe (typically 10 days) is a leading cause of application denial. Check your Gateway inbox and your physical mailbox regularly after applying.
steps.es: 6. Responder rapidamente a cualquier solicitud de informacion adicional de DFCS. DFCS envia avisos a traves de su cuenta de Gateway y por correo. No responder dentro del plazo solicitado (tipicamente 10 dias) es una causa principal de denegacion de solicitud.

steps.en: 7. Wait for your eligibility determination notice. Most Georgia Medicaid applications are decided within 45 days. Pregnancy applications are decided within 15 days under federal expedited-processing rules. If your application is approved, you will receive a Medicaid card in the mail. If denied, the notice will include the specific reason and your appeal rights.
steps.es: 7. Esperar el aviso de determinacion de elegibilidad. La mayoria de las solicitudes de Medicaid de Georgia se deciden dentro de 45 dias. Las solicitudes de embarazo se deciden dentro de 15 dias bajo las reglas federales de procesamiento acelerado.

documentsNeeded.en: Photo ID for the head of household (Georgia driver's license, state ID card, or valid U.S. passport)
documentsNeeded.es: Identificacion con foto para el jefe de hogar (licencia de conducir de Georgia, tarjeta de identificacion estatal o pasaporte valido de EE.UU.)

documentsNeeded.en: Social Security Number (or proof of application for SSN) for every household member applying for coverage
documentsNeeded.es: Numero de Seguro Social (o comprobante de solicitud de SSN) para cada miembro del hogar que solicite cobertura

documentsNeeded.en: Proof of Georgia residency: utility bill, lease agreement, mortgage statement, or other official mail showing your current Georgia address
documentsNeeded.es: Comprobante de residencia en Georgia: factura de servicios publicos, contrato de arrendamiento, estado de cuenta hipotecario u otro correo oficial que muestre su direccion actual en Georgia

documentsNeeded.en: Proof of U.S. citizenship or qualifying immigration status (U.S. birth certificate, U.S. passport, Certificate of Naturalization, Permanent Resident Card, or other USCIS documentation)
documentsNeeded.es: Comprobante de ciudadania estadounidense o estatus migratorio calificado (acta de nacimiento estadounidense, pasaporte de EE.UU., Certificado de Naturalizacion, Tarjeta de Residente Permanente u otra documentacion de USCIS)

documentsNeeded.en: Proof of income: last 30 days of pay stubs for each employed household member; or most recent federal tax return plus 12 months of income records for self-employed applicants
documentsNeeded.es: Comprobante de ingresos: ultimos 30 dias de talones de pago para cada miembro del hogar empleado; o la declaracion de impuestos federal mas reciente mas 12 meses de registros de ingresos para solicitantes con autoempleo

documentsNeeded.en: Georgia Pathways applicants only: Documentation of qualifying activities for the past 30 days, such as pay stubs or an employer letter (employment), enrollment verification (education), community service organization letter (community service), or other activity-specific documentation
documentsNeeded.es: Solo solicitantes de Georgia Pathways: Documentacion de actividades calificadas de los ultimos 30 dias, como talones de pago o carta del empleador (empleo), verificacion de inscripcion (educacion), carta de organizacion de servicio comunitario (servicio comunitario) u otra documentacion especifica de actividad

processingTimeline.en: Standard Georgia Medicaid applications are decided within 45 days. Pregnancy Medicaid applications are decided within 15 days under federal expedited rules. Georgia Pathways applications follow standard Medicaid timelines (45 days) but may take longer if DFCS needs additional documentation of qualifying activities. ABD (aged, blind, disabled) Medicaid applications that require a medical disability determination can take 60 to 90 days. Retroactive eligibility covers up to 3 months before the application date for most categories.
processingTimeline.es: Las solicitudes estandar de Medicaid de Georgia se deciden dentro de 45 dias. Las solicitudes de Medicaid de embarazo se deciden dentro de 15 dias bajo las reglas federales aceleradas. Las solicitudes de Georgia Pathways siguen los plazos estandar de Medicaid (45 dias) pero pueden tardar mas si DFCS necesita documentacion adicional de actividades calificadas.

commonDenialReasons.en: Income above the applicable threshold: Household income exceeds 100% FPL for Pathways, 133% FPL for children, or 220% FPL for pregnant women. This is the most common single reason for denial across all Georgia Medicaid categories.
commonDenialReasons.es: Ingresos superiores al umbral aplicable: Los ingresos del hogar superan el 100% del FPL para Pathways, el 133% del FPL para ninos, o el 220% del FPL para mujeres embarazadas. Esta es la razon mas comun para la denegacion.

commonDenialReasons.en: Failure to meet Pathways activity requirement: Adult applicants who do not document 80 hours per month of qualifying activities are denied Pathways coverage. Parents of children under age 6 are exempt. If you are in this group and were denied for activity reasons, contact DFCS immediately.
commonDenialReasons.es: No cumplir con el requisito de actividad de Pathways: Los solicitantes adultos que no documentan 80 horas por mes de actividades calificadas son denegados de la cobertura de Pathways.

commonDenialReasons.en: Failure to respond to information requests: DFCS sends requests for additional documentation through the Gateway portal and by mail. Not responding within 10 days typically results in denial. Check your Gateway inbox frequently.
commonDenialReasons.es: No responder a las solicitudes de informacion: DFCS envia solicitudes de documentacion adicional a traves del portal Gateway y por correo. No responder dentro de 10 dias tipicamente resulta en denegacion.

commonDenialReasons.en: Residency or citizenship documentation gaps: Applications missing proof of Georgia residency or qualifying immigration status are routinely denied. Make sure every document includes your name and current Georgia address.
commonDenialReasons.es: Faltas en la documentacion de residencia o ciudadania: Las solicitudes sin comprobante de residencia en Georgia o estatus migratorio calificado son rutinariamente denegadas.

commonDenialReasons.en: Adult without qualifying category: An adult ages 19 to 64 who does not qualify through Pathways (due to income, activity, or exemption status), who does not have dependent children, and who is not pregnant, disabled, or 65 or older typically does not qualify for any Georgia Medicaid category. These adults may qualify for ACA marketplace coverage at Healthcare.gov.
commonDenialReasons.es: Adulto sin categoria calificada: Un adulto de 19 a 64 anos que no califica a traves de Pathways, que no tiene hijos dependientes y que no esta embarazada, discapacitado o tiene 65 anos o mas tipicamente no califica para ninguna categoria de Medicaid de Georgia.

heading.en: If your child's family income is over the Georgia Medicaid limit: PeachCare for Kids (CHIP)
heading.es: Si los ingresos familiares de su hijo superan el limite de Medicaid de Georgia: PeachCare for Kids (CHIP)

body.en: Georgia PeachCare for Kids is the state's Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP), covering uninsured children under age 19 in households with incomes between 134% and 247% of the Federal Poverty Level. For 2026, Georgia DCH publishes the 247% FPL PeachCare limit as $37,200 per year ($3,100 per month) for a household of one and $77,064 per year ($6,422 per month) for a household of four. PeachCare covers preventive care, doctor visits, prescriptions, dental, vision, and mental health services. Children under age 6 qualify at no premium cost; older children may have a small monthly premium based on household income. PeachCare applications go through the same Georgia Gateway portal at gateway.ga.gov. If your child earns too much for Georgia Medicaid (133% FPL) but less than 247% FPL, PeachCare is the coverage bridge. The same Gateway application checks eligibility for both programs simultaneously.
body.es: Georgia PeachCare for Kids es el Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos (CHIP) del estado, que cubre a ninos no asegurados menores de 19 anos en hogares con ingresos entre el 134% y el 247% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Para 2026, Georgia DCH publica el limite de PeachCare al 247% del FPL como $37,200 por ano ($3,100 por mes) para un hogar de una persona y $77,064 por ano ($6,422 por mes) para un hogar de cuatro. PeachCare cubre atencion preventiva, visitas al medico, medicamentos recetados, servicios dentales, vision y salud mental.

heading.en: If you are 65 or older with limited income: Georgia Medicare Savings Programs
heading.es: Si tiene 65 anos o mas con ingresos limitados: Programas de Ahorro de Medicare de Georgia

body.en: Georgia administers four Medicare Savings Programs (MSPs) for low-income Medicare beneficiaries, helping pay Medicare Part B premiums, Part A premiums, deductibles, and coinsurance. The four MSP tiers in Georgia are: Qualified Medicare Beneficiary (QMB, up to 100% FPL), Specified Low-Income Medicare Beneficiary (SLMB, 100-120% FPL), Qualifying Individual (QI, 120-135% FPL), and Qualified Disabled Working Individual (QDWI, up to 200% FPL for disabled workers who lost Medicare due to returning to work). Georgia Medicaid dual-eligible beneficiaries who qualify for QMB pay no out-of-pocket costs for Medicare-covered services; providers cannot bill them for copays or deductibles. Apply through gateway.ga.gov or call 877-423-4746. Enrollment in an MSP automatically enrolls you in the Part D Extra Help (Low Income Subsidy) program, which reduces prescription drug costs.
body.es: Georgia administra cuatro Programas de Ahorro de Medicare (MSPs) para beneficiarios de Medicare con ingresos bajos, ayudando a pagar las primas de la Parte B de Medicare, las primas de la Parte A, los deducibles y los coseguros. Los cuatro niveles de MSP en Georgia son: Beneficiario Calificado de Medicare (QMB, hasta el 100% del FPL), Beneficiario Especificado de Medicare de Bajos Ingresos (SLMB, 100-120% del FPL), Individuo Calificado (QI, 120-135% del FPL) y Individuo Discapacitado con Empleo Calificado (QDWI, hasta el 200% del FPL).

en.question: What is the Georgia Medicaid income limit for a family of 4 in 2026?
en.answer: It depends on the population group. For adults applying through Georgia Pathways to Coverage, the 2026 income limit is $33,000 per year (100% of the Federal Poverty Level) for a household of four, and applicants must also complete 80 hours per month of qualifying activities. Pregnant women in a household of four qualify up to $72,600 per year (220% FPL). Children in a household of four qualify for Georgia Medicaid up to $43,890 per year (133% FPL), and PeachCare for Kids (CHIP) extends coverage to approximately $77,064 per year (247% FPL per Georgia DCH) for a household of four. Traditional parent/caretaker Medicaid has a much lower cap of approximately 35% FPL, or about $11,550 per year for a household of four.

en.question: What is Georgia Pathways to Coverage and how does it differ from full Medicaid expansion?
en.answer: Georgia Pathways to Coverage is a CMS-approved partial Medicaid expansion that covers adults ages 19 to 64 with household income at or below 100% of the Federal Poverty Level who complete at least 80 hours per month of qualifying activities. Full Medicaid expansion, adopted by 40 states and DC, covers all adults up to 138% FPL with no activity requirement. Georgia's Pathways program is more restrictive in two ways: the income limit is 100% FPL rather than 138% FPL, and the 80-hour activity requirement adds a non-income hurdle that does not exist in full-expansion states. Pathways is approved through December 31, 2026. The federal government, not Georgia, pays 90% of expansion costs.

en.question: What counts as income for Georgia Medicaid (MAGI definition)?
en.answer: Georgia Medicaid uses Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI), which is essentially your federal taxable income plus a few additions. Counted income includes wages, salaries, tips, self-employment net income, SSDI benefits (taxable portion), Social Security retirement benefits (taxable portion), unemployment compensation, interest, dividends, capital gains, pension distributions, and alimony under pre-2019 divorce decrees. Not counted: SSI payments, child support received, veterans' VA disability or pension benefits, workers' compensation, TANF cash assistance, gifts, and inheritances. Georgia does not apply the federal 5% MAGI disregard for Pathways, so the posted 100% FPL limit is the hard cutoff.

en.question: What documents do I need to apply for Georgia Medicaid?
en.answer: To apply for Georgia Medicaid through gateway.ga.gov or at a DFCS office, you typically need: (1) photo ID for the head of household; (2) Social Security Numbers for all household members applying; (3) proof of Georgia residency (utility bill, lease, or other official mail with your address); (4) proof of citizenship or qualifying immigration status; and (5) last 30 days of pay stubs or most recent tax return. For Georgia Pathways, also bring documentation of your qualifying activities for the past 30 days (pay stubs, employer letter, enrollment verification, or community service records). Gathering all documents before you start avoids the 10-day information-request deadline that is the leading cause of application denial.

en.question: What happens if I am denied Georgia Medicaid?
en.answer: Georgia Medicaid denial notices include the specific reason for denial and your appeal rights. You have 30 days from the denial notice date to request a fair hearing through the Georgia Office of State Administrative Hearings (OSAH). Request an appeal in writing and submit it to DFCS. During the appeal, your existing coverage (if any) may continue at the same level. Common denial reasons include income above the applicable threshold, failure to document Pathways qualifying activities, missing documentation, or falling into the coverage gap (adult without dependent children who does not qualify through Pathways). Georgia Legal Services Program (georgialegalservices.org) provides free legal help with Medicaid appeals for income-eligible Georgians.

en.question: Can I work and still qualify for Georgia Medicaid?
en.answer: Yes, and for Georgia Pathways to Coverage, working is actually required. Pathways requires adults ages 19 to 64 to complete at least 80 hours per month of qualifying activities, which include paid employment, self-employment, job skills training, higher education, community service, or caregiving for a child under age 6. Income from work still counts toward the 100% FPL income limit. Working adults whose income exceeds 100% FPL through Pathways but remains below 138% FPL fall into a coverage gap unique to Georgia: they earn too much for Pathways but too little for marketplace subsidies that start at 100% FPL in full-expansion states. Check Healthcare.gov for ACA marketplace options.

en.question: Is Georgia a Medicaid expansion state?
en.answer: Georgia is considered a partial expansion state. Georgia implemented the Georgia Pathways to Coverage program in 2023, which extends Medicaid to adults ages 19 to 64 with incomes up to 100% FPL who meet an 80-hour monthly activity requirement. Georgia has not adopted the full ACA Medicaid expansion to 138% FPL with no activity requirement. As of 2026, 40 states and DC have full expansion; Georgia and Wisconsin are the only states with partial or conditional expansion rather than the standard 138% FPL model. Georgians who fall above Pathways eligibility but below full-expansion income thresholds may qualify for ACA marketplace plans at Healthcare.gov.

en.question: How long does a Georgia Medicaid application take?
en.answer: Standard Georgia Medicaid applications are decided within 45 days of submission. Pregnancy Medicaid applications are fast-tracked and decided within 15 days under federal expedited-processing rules. Georgia Pathways applications follow the 45-day standard timeline but may take longer if DFCS needs additional activity documentation. ABD (aged, blind, disabled) applications that require a disability determination can take 60 to 90 days. Georgia Medicaid can approve coverage retroactively for up to 3 months before the application date for most categories. Check your Georgia Gateway account regularly for status updates and document requests.

en.question: Does Georgia Medicaid cover dental and vision?
en.answer: Georgia Medicaid covers dental and vision for children through both the standard Medicaid benefit and PeachCare for Kids. For adults, Georgia Medicaid (including Pathways) provides limited dental coverage. Adult dental benefits under Georgia Medicaid cover emergency extractions and limited preventive services; comprehensive adult dental (cleanings, fillings, crowns) is typically not covered under standard Georgia Medicaid managed-care plans. Vision care for adults is similarly limited. Beneficiaries should check with their assigned Georgia Medicaid managed-care organization (Amerigroup, CareSource, Peach State Health Management, or WellCare) for exact dental and vision benefits available on their plan.

es.question: Cual es el limite de ingresos de Medicaid de Georgia para una familia de 4 en 2026?
es.answer: Depende del grupo de poblacion. Para adultos que solicitan a traves de Georgia Pathways to Coverage, el limite de ingresos 2026 es de $33,000 por ano (100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza) para un hogar de cuatro, y los solicitantes tambien deben completar 80 horas por mes de actividades calificadas. Las mujeres embarazadas en un hogar de cuatro califican hasta $72,600 por ano (220% del FPL). Los ninos en un hogar de cuatro califican para Medicaid de Georgia hasta $43,890 por ano (133% del FPL), y PeachCare for Kids (CHIP) extiende la cobertura a aproximadamente $77,064 por ano (247% del FPL segun Georgia DCH) para un hogar de cuatro.

es.question: Que es Georgia Pathways to Coverage y como se diferencia de la expansion completa de Medicaid?
es.answer: Georgia Pathways to Coverage es una expansion parcial de Medicaid aprobada por CMS que cubre a adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos del hogar al o por debajo del 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza que completan al menos 80 horas por mes de actividades calificadas. La expansion completa de Medicaid, adoptada por 40 estados y DC, cubre a todos los adultos hasta el 138% del FPL sin requisito de actividad. El programa Pathways de Georgia es mas restrictivo de dos maneras: el limite de ingresos es el 100% del FPL en lugar del 138% del FPL, y el requisito de actividad de 80 horas agrega un obstaculo que no existe en los estados de expansion completa.

es.question: Que cuenta como ingreso para Medicaid de Georgia (definicion MAGI)?
es.answer: Medicaid de Georgia utiliza el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI), que es esencialmente su ingreso imponible federal mas algunas adiciones. Los ingresos contados incluyen salarios, sueldos, propinas, ingresos netos por autoempleo, beneficios de SSDI (porcion imponible), beneficios de jubilacion del Seguro Social (porcion imponible), compensacion por desempleo, intereses, dividendos, ganancias de capital, distribuciones de pension y pension alimenticia bajo decretos de divorcio anteriores a 2019. No se cuentan: pagos de SSI, manutencion infantil recibida, beneficios de VA, compensacion de trabajadores, asistencia en efectivo de TANF, regalos y herencias.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para solicitar Medicaid de Georgia?
es.answer: Para solicitar Medicaid de Georgia a traves de gateway.ga.gov o en una oficina de DFCS, generalmente necesita: (1) identificacion con foto para el jefe de hogar; (2) Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar que soliciten; (3) comprobante de residencia en Georgia; (4) comprobante de ciudadania o estatus migratorio calificado; y (5) ultimos 30 dias de talones de pago o declaracion de impuestos mas reciente. Para Georgia Pathways, tambien traiga documentacion de sus actividades calificadas de los ultimos 30 dias.

es.question: Que sucede si me niegan Medicaid de Georgia?
es.answer: Los avisos de denegacion de Medicaid de Georgia incluyen la razon especifica de la denegacion y sus derechos de apelacion. Tiene 30 dias desde la fecha del aviso de denegacion para solicitar una audiencia justa a traves de la Oficina de Audiencias Administrativas del Estado de Georgia (OSAH). Solicite una apelacion por escrito y enviela a DFCS. El Programa de Servicios Juridicos de Georgia (georgialegalservices.org) proporciona ayuda legal gratuita con apelaciones de Medicaid para georgianos elegibles por ingresos.

es.question: Puedo trabajar y aun calificar para Medicaid de Georgia?
es.answer: Si, y para Georgia Pathways to Coverage, trabajar es en realidad un requisito. Pathways requiere que los adultos de 19 a 64 anos completen al menos 80 horas por mes de actividades calificadas, que incluyen empleo remunerado, autoempleo, capacitacion laboral, educacion superior, servicio comunitario o cuidado de un nino menor de 6 anos. Los ingresos del trabajo aun cuentan hacia el limite de ingresos del 100% del FPL.

es.question: Es Georgia un estado de expansion de Medicaid?
es.answer: Georgia se considera un estado de expansion parcial. Georgia implemento el programa Georgia Pathways to Coverage en 2023, que extiende Medicaid a adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos de hasta el 100% del FPL que cumplen un requisito de actividad mensual de 80 horas. Georgia no ha adoptado la expansion completa del ACA de Medicaid al 138% del FPL sin requisito de actividad. A partir de 2026, 40 estados y DC tienen expansion completa; Georgia y Wisconsin son los unicos estados con expansion parcial o condicional.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tarda una solicitud de Medicaid de Georgia?
es.answer: Las solicitudes estandar de Medicaid de Georgia se deciden dentro de 45 dias de la presentacion. Las solicitudes de Medicaid de embarazo se aceleran y se deciden dentro de 15 dias bajo las reglas federales de procesamiento acelerado. Las solicitudes de Georgia Pathways siguen el plazo estandar de 45 dias pero pueden tardar mas si DFCS necesita documentacion adicional de actividades. Las solicitudes de ABD que requieren una determinacion de discapacidad pueden tardar de 60 a 90 dias.

es.question: Medicaid de Georgia cubre servicios dentales y de vision?
es.answer: Medicaid de Georgia cubre servicios dentales y de vision para ninos a traves del beneficio estandar de Medicaid y PeachCare for Kids. Para adultos, Medicaid de Georgia (incluido Pathways) proporciona cobertura dental limitada. Los beneficios dentales para adultos bajo Medicaid de Georgia cubren extracciones de emergencia y servicios preventivos limitados; los servicios dentales integrales para adultos tipicamente no estan cubiertos. Los beneficiarios deben verificar con su organizacion de atencion administrada de Medicaid de Georgia asignada los beneficios dentales y de vision exactos disponibles en su plan.
